title: My Own SLP - Videos
description:
I'm Rachel & I've worked as a Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) for over a decade supporting children with speech & language difficulties. I have also interacted with many families who’s children did not qualify for speech therapy or who couldn't access the needed services. I want any child who is struggling to communicate to have support & so I have created this channel to provide resources for anyone in need! 

I provide videos helping parents know if their child needs help with speech, which sounds to work on, how to work on each sound, & the proven sequence to follow. I also share how to make this process fun & engaging. New videos will come out every month so be sure to subscribe to my channel so you won't miss any new videos! I'm glad you're here! 

Needing additional resources and guidance to help your child improve their speech? Check out my speech programs or book a 1:1 consultation with me to get your questions answered: www.myownslp.com
